examples.text_en: His answer was succinct and easy to understand.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答简洁易懂。

examples.text_en: She gave a succinct report of the whole trip.
examples.text_zh: 她就整个行程做了一份简洁的报告。

examples.text_en: The lost walkers needed succor in the cold night.
examples.text_zh: 迷路的行人在寒夜里需要救援。

examples.text_en: They brought succor to the poor family at once.
examples.text_zh: 他们立刻给这户穷人家送去了援助。

examples.text_en: There was a sufficiency of food for everyone.
examples.text_zh: 食物对每个人都足够。

examples.text_en: The old farm had a sufficiency of clean water.
examples.text_zh: 这座旧农场有充足的清洁用水。

examples.text_en: The room was sufficiently warm for the children.
examples.text_zh: 房间对孩子来说足够暖和。

examples.text_en: He did not rest sufficiently before the long trip.
examples.text_zh: 长途旅行前他没有充分休息。

examples.text_en: The thick smoke could suffocate a small child.
examples.text_zh: 浓烟会使小孩窒息。

examples.text_en: He felt as if the hot room would suffocate him.
examples.text_zh: 他觉得这闷热的房间快让他窒息了。

examples.text_en: Women fought for many years to win suffrage.
examples.text_zh: 妇女为赢得选举权奋斗了许多年。

examples.text_en: The right of suffrage is important in a democracy.
examples.text_zh: 选举权在民主制度中十分重要。

examples.text_en: The old suffragist spoke at the city meeting.
examples.text_zh: 这位年迈的妇女参政权论者在市集会上发言。

examples.text_en: A brave suffragist changed the history of voting.
examples.text_zh: 一位勇敢的参政权运动者改变了投票的历史。

examples.text_en: A warm light began to suffuse the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 温暖的光开始弥漫整个房间。

examples.text_en: Joy seemed to suffuse her face and her voice.
examples.text_zh: 喜悦似乎充满了她的脸和声音。

examples.text_en: His words were suggestive but not at all clear.
examples.text_zh: 他的话有暗示性，却一点也不明确。

examples.text_en: The picture gave a suggestive hint about the story.
examples.text_zh: 这幅画对这故事作了暗示性的提示。

examples.text_en: They stayed in a large suite at the old hotel.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在老酒店一间宽敞的套房里。

examples.text_en: The band played a short suite for the guests.
examples.text_zh: 乐队为客人演奏了一首短组曲。

examples.text_en: The sulky child would not speak to anyone.
examples.text_zh: 这个生气的孩子不愿跟任何人说话。

examples.text_en: He sat in a sulky silence all the evening.
examples.text_zh: 他整个晚上都闷闷不乐地坐着。

examples.text_en: His sullen face told us he was still angry.
examples.text_zh: 他阴沉的脸告诉我们他还在生气。

examples.text_en: The sky was sullen before the heavy rain.
examples.text_zh: 大雨前天空阴沉沉的。

examples.text_en: He did not want to sully his good name.
examples.text_zh: 他不想玷污自己的好名声。

examples.text_en: One bad act can sully a whole life of work.
examples.text_zh: 一次坏行为就能玷污一辈子的努力。

examples.text_en: The air had a strong smell of sulphur.
examples.text_zh: 空气里有浓烈的硫磺味。

examples.text_en: They found sulphur near the hot dark rocks.
examples.text_zh: 他们在滚烫的深色岩石附近发现了硫。

examples.text_en: It was a sultry night with no cool wind.
examples.text_zh: 那是个闷热的夜晚，没有一丝凉风。

examples.text_en: The sultry air made everyone feel slow and tired.
examples.text_zh: 闷热的空气让每个人都感到迟钝疲惫。

examples.text_en: The old rule was summarily dropped by the group.
examples.text_zh: 这条旧规定被小组立刻废除了。

examples.text_en: He was summarily told to leave the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 他当即被叫出整个房间。

examples.text_en: The summation of all the numbers was easy.
examples.text_zh: 所有数字的总和很容易算出。

examples.text_en: She gave a short summation of the whole report.
examples.text_zh: 她给整份报告做了一段简短的总述。

examples.text_en: The guests enjoyed a sumptuous meal in the great hall.
examples.text_zh: 客人们在大厅里享用了一顿奢华的饭菜。

examples.text_en: Her dress was sumptuous and full of bright colors.
examples.text_zh: 她的裙子华丽而色彩鲜艳。

examples.text_en: He got a bad sunburn on his back and arms.
examples.text_zh: 他的背和手臂被晒得严重发红。

examples.text_en: A sunburn made her whole face red and warm.
examples.text_zh: 晒伤让她的整张脸又红又烫。

examples.text_en: The sunburnt child had skin of deep brown.
examples.text_zh: 这个晒黑的孩子皮肤呈深棕色。

examples.text_en: His sunburnt face showed he worked in the fields.
examples.text_zh: 他晒黑的脸说明他在田里干活。

examples.text_en: Nothing could sunder the love between the two.
examples.text_zh: 什么也无法把两人的爱分开。

examples.text_en: The long war would sunder many poor families.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的战争会拆散许多贫穷的家庭。

examples.text_en: The old sundial stood in the middle of the garden.
examples.text_zh: 古老的日晷立在花园中央。

examples.text_en: A sundial shows the time by the light of the sun.
examples.text_zh: 日晷靠阳光来显示时间。

examples.text_en: The box was full of sundry small old things.
examples.text_zh: 箱子里装满了各式各样的小旧物。

examples.text_en: They bought sundry goods at the small market.
examples.text_zh: 他们在这个小市场上买了各种杂货。

examples.text_en: The sunlit room felt warm and full of hope.
examples.text_zh: 阳光照射的房间温暖而充满希望。

examples.text_en: They walked through the sunlit fields all morning.
examples.text_zh: 他们整个上午都走在阳光照耀的田野上。

examples.text_en: The superannuated worker was given a fine party.
examples.text_zh: 这位年老退休的工人得到了一个温馨的欢送会。

examples.text_en: These superannuated machines no longer work well.
examples.text_zh: 这些过时的机器已经不好使了。

examples.text_en: She gave a superb performance at the city hall.
examples.text_zh: 她在市政厅献上了一场极好的演出。

examples.text_en: The food at the small hotel was simply superb.
examples.text_zh: 这家小旅馆的饭菜简直好极了。

examples.text_en: His supercilious smile made the whole room cold.
examples.text_zh: 他傲慢的微笑让整个房间冷了下来。

examples.text_en: She gave a supercilious look at the poor man.
examples.text_zh: 她傲慢地看了那个穷人一眼。

examples.text_en: The old supercontinent broke into several smaller lands.
examples.text_zh: 古老的超大陆分裂成了几块较小的陆地。

examples.text_en: Scientists study how a supercontinent forms and breaks.
examples.text_zh: 科学家研究超大陆如何形成和分裂。

examples.text_en: The talk was full of superficiality and empty words.
examples.text_zh: 这场谈话满是肤浅和空话。

examples.text_en: He was tired of the superficiality of city life.
examples.text_zh: 他厌倦了城市生活的肤浅。

examples.text_en: The two plans look superficially the same.
examples.text_zh: 这两个计划表面上看起来一样。

examples.text_en: He knew the subject only superficially.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个题目只是肤浅地了解。

examples.text_en: There was a superfluity of food at the party.
examples.text_zh: 聚会上食物过剩。

examples.text_en: He gave away the superfluity of his old books.
examples.text_zh: 他把多余的书都送人了。

examples.text_en: They superheat the water to make it very hot.
examples.text_zh: 他们把水过热处理，使其变得非常烫。

examples.text_en: The machine can superheat the air in minutes.
examples.text_zh: 这台机器几分钟内就能把空气加热到过热。

examples.text_en: They superimpose one picture on top of another.
examples.text_zh: 他们把一张图片叠在另一张上面。

examples.text_en: He would superimpose his own words on the old text.
examples.text_zh: 他会把自己的话叠加到旧文本上。

examples.text_en: A good teacher can superintend the whole class.
examples.text_zh: 好老师能管理整个班级。

examples.text_en: She was asked to superintend the new project.
examples.text_zh: 她被请来监督这个新项目。

examples.text_en: The superintendent of the building lives on the first floor.
examples.text_zh: 这栋楼的主管住在一楼。

examples.text_en: The school superintendent spoke to all the parents.
examples.text_zh: 学校的督学对全体家长讲了话。

examples.text_en: He felt a quiet superiority over the other team.
examples.text_zh: 他对另一支队伍怀有暗暗的优越感。

examples.text_en: They believed in their own superiority and lost.
examples.text_zh: 他们自认高人一等，结果输了。

examples.text_en: Her work was of superlative quality from the start.
examples.text_zh: 她的作品从一开始就质量绝佳。

examples.text_en: He used superlative words to describe the old city.
examples.text_zh: 他用最上等的词来形容这座古城。

examples.text_en: In the story a superman saves the whole city.
examples.text_zh: 故事里一个超人拯救了整座城市。

examples.text_en: He was called a superman for his great strength.
examples.text_zh: 他因为力大无穷而被称作超人。

examples.text_en: The old story is full of supernatural events.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的故事充满了超自然的事件。

examples.text_en: She believed in a supernatural world beyond ours.
examples.text_zh: 她相信在我们之外还有一个超自然的世界。

examples.text_en: A supernova can shine brighter than a whole galaxy.
examples.text_zh: 一颗超新星可以比整个星系还亮。

examples.text_en: They watched a distant supernova through the big telescope.
examples.text_zh: 他们用大望远镜观测了一颗遥远的超新星。

examples.text_en: The new rule will supersede all the older ones.
examples.text_zh: 新规定将取代所有旧规定。

examples.text_en: No machine can supersede the work of a good mind.
examples.text_zh: 没有机器能取代好头脑的工作。

examples.text_en: The supersonic plane flew high above the clouds.
examples.text_zh: 这架超音速飞机高飞在云层之上。

examples.text_en: A supersonic flight can cross the ocean quickly.
examples.text_zh: 超音速飞行可以很快飞越大洋。

examples.text_en: The old woman was superstitious about small black cats.
examples.text_zh: 这位老妇人对黑猫很迷信。

examples.text_en: He was too superstitious to walk under the ladder.
examples.text_zh: 他太迷信了，不敢从梯子下走过。

examples.text_en: The superstructure of the ship was made of steel.
examples.text_zh: 这艘船的上部构造是钢制的。

examples.text_en: They built the superstructure above the strong stone base.
examples.text_zh: 他们在坚固的石基上建起了上层建筑。

examples.text_en: A teacher will supervise the children at the pool.
examples.text_zh: 老师会在游泳池边照看孩子们。

examples.text_en: She had to supervise the whole night work.
examples.text_zh: 她必须监督整个夜间的工作。

examples.text_en: The children play here under the close supervision of adults.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们在大人密切的监督下在这里玩耍。

examples.text_en: The work was done without any supervision at all.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作是完全没有监督地完成的。

examples.text_en: My supervisor asked about the whole first plan.
examples.text_zh: 我的主管询问了整个初步计划。

examples.text_en: The supervisor gave the team clear and simple rules.
examples.text_zh: 主管给团队制定了清楚简单的规定。

examples.text_en: He lay supine on the soft ground and slept.
examples.text_zh: 他仰卧在柔软的地上睡着了。

examples.text_en: The supine man did nothing all the long day.
examples.text_zh: 这个懒散的人一整天什么也没做。

examples.text_en: New machines began to supplant the old workers.
examples.text_zh: 新机器开始取代老工人。

examples.text_en: No one can supplant her as the team leader.
examples.text_zh: 没有人能取代她做队长。

examples.text_en: The supple young tree bent in the strong wind.
examples.text_zh: 这棵柔韧的小树在强风中弯下了腰。

examples.text_en: Her supple fingers moved quickly over the keys.
examples.text_zh: 她柔软的手指在琴键上飞快移动。

examples.text_en: He takes a vitamin supplement with his breakfast.
examples.text_zh: 他早餐时服用一种维生素补充剂。

examples.text_en: This book is a supplement to the first one.
examples.text_zh: 这本书是第一本的补充。

examples.text_en: They asked for supplementary help with the project.
examples.text_zh: 他们请求为这个项目提供补充帮助。

examples.text_en: A supplementary page was added to the report.
examples.text_zh: 报告里增加了一页补充内容。

examples.text_en: The doctor spoke about the supplementation of their food.
examples.text_zh: 医生谈到了他们食物的营养补充。

examples.text_en: Good supplementation can help the body stay strong.
examples.text_zh: 良好的补充有助于身体保持强壮。

examples.text_en: The suppliant voice came from behind the old door.
examples.text_zh: 恳求的声音从旧门后传来。

examples.text_en: He gave her a suppliant look and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他用哀求的眼神看了她一眼，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: A poor supplicant stood at the door for hours.
examples.text_zh: 一个可怜的恳求者在门口站了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: The old king gave the supplicant a little food.
examples.text_zh: 老国王给了这个哀求者一点食物。

examples.text_en: He would supplicate the chief for one more chance.
examples.text_zh: 他会向首领恳求再给一次机会。

examples.text_en: She began to supplicate for the life of her son.
examples.text_zh: 她开始为儿子的性命哀求。

examples.text_en: The team showed its supremacy in the final game.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍在决赛中显示出压倒性的优势。

examples.text_en: They fought for supremacy over the whole market.
examples.text_zh: 他们为争夺整个市场的霸权而斗争。

examples.text_en: The hotel added a surcharge to the whole bill.
examples.text_zh: 酒店在账单上加了附加费。

examples.text_en: There is a small surcharge for using a card.
examples.text_zh: 使用银行卡有一笔小小的附加费。

examples.text_en: After the surfeit of food he felt quite ill.
examples.text_zh: 吃得太撑之后他觉得很不好受。

examples.text_en: A surfeit of sweet things is bad for you.
examples.text_zh: 甜食吃过量对你没好处。

examples.text_en: The surging water carried the small boat away.
examples.text_zh: 汹涌的水流把小船冲走了。

examples.text_en: We heard the surging of the sea all night.
examples.text_zh: 我们整夜都听见大海的浪涌声。

examples.text_en: The surly waiter never smiled at the guests.
examples.text_zh: 这个粗暴的服务员从不对客人微笑。

examples.text_en: He gave a surly answer and walked out.
examples.text_zh: 他凶巴巴地答了一句就走了出去。

examples.text_en: My surmise about the whole answer was correct.
examples.text_zh: 我对整个答案的猜测是正确的。

examples.text_en: They could only surmise the cause of the fire.
examples.text_zh: 他们只能猜测火灾的原因。

examples.text_en: They had to surmount many hard problems that year.
examples.text_zh: 他们那年必须克服许多难题。

examples.text_en: She could surmount her fear with the team's help.
examples.text_zh: 在团队的帮助下她战胜了恐惧。

examples.text_en: The view from the top was surpassingly beautiful.
examples.text_zh: 从顶上望去，景色美得超群。

examples.text_en: Her voice was surpassingly clear in the old hall.
examples.text_zh: 她的嗓音在旧厅堂里清亮得超凡。

examples.text_en: The small team won surprisingly against the champions.
examples.text_zh: 这支小队伍出人意料地战胜了冠军。

examples.text_en: Surprisingly, the old car started on the first try.
examples.text_zh: 令人惊讶的是，那辆旧车第一次就发动了。

examples.text_en: The museum showed a fine collection of surrealism.
examples.text_zh: 博物馆展出精美的超现实主义藏品。

examples.text_en: Surrealism changed the way many artists saw the world.
examples.text_zh: 超现实主义改变了许多艺术家看世界的方式。

examples.text_en: He took a surreptitious look at the letter.
examples.text_zh: 他偷偷地看了一眼那封信。

examples.text_en: Their surreptitious meeting was held after dark.
examples.text_zh: 他们的秘密会面在天黑后举行。

examples.text_en: She acted as a surrogate mother for her sister.
examples.text_zh: 她为姐姐做了代孕母亲。

examples.text_en: This old box is a surrogate for a real table.
examples.text_zh: 这个旧箱子是真正桌子的替代品。

examples.text_en: The surveyor measured the whole field with care.
examples.text_zh: 测量员仔细丈量了整片田地。

examples.text_en: A surveyor came to check the old stone wall.
examples.text_zh: 一位测量员来检查那堵老石墙。

examples.text_en: The survivability of the small plants was surprising.
examples.text_zh: 这些小植物的生存能力令人惊讶。

examples.text_en: They studied the survivability of the fish in cold water.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了鱼在冷水中的生存能力。

examples.text_en: His susceptibility to colds was a real problem.
examples.text_zh: 他容易感冒，这确实是个问题。

examples.text_en: The doctor noted her susceptibility to that illness.
examples.text_zh: 医生注意到她对那种病很敏感。

examples.text_en: One suspender broke and his trousers fell down.
examples.text_zh: 一根吊裤带断了，他的裤子掉了下来。

examples.text_en: He wore a red suspender with his dark trousers.
examples.text_zh: 他在深色裤子上系着一条红色吊裤带。

examples.text_en: The whole film kept us in great suspense.
examples.text_zh: 整部电影让我们一直悬念重重。

examples.text_en: She waited in suspense for the final answer.
examples.text_zh: 她紧张不安地等待最后的答复。

examples.text_en: The bridge has a fine suspension of steel wires.
examples.text_zh: 这座桥由钢索巧妙悬挂而成。

examples.text_en: The game was put in suspension after the rain.
examples.text_zh: 雨后比赛被暂停了。

examples.text_en: They brought sustenance to the workers in the field.
examples.text_zh: 他们把食物送到了田里的工人那里。

examples.text_en: The poor family had little sustenance for the winter.
examples.text_zh: 这户穷人家过冬的食物很少。

examples.text_en: The doctor put a fine suture in the small wound.
examples.text_zh: 医生在小伤口上缝了一针。

examples.text_en: A clean suture will help the cut heal well.
examples.text_zh: 干净的缝合线有助于伤口愈合。

examples.text_en: The svelte young woman moved with easy grace.
examples.text_zh: 这位苗条的年轻女子举止优雅从容。

examples.text_en: He drove a svelte black car into the city.
examples.text_zh: 他开着一辆线条流畅的黑色汽车进城。

examples.text_en: He walked with a proud swagger into the room.
examples.text_zh: 他大摇大摆地走进房间。

examples.text_en: His swagger annoyed the whole other team.
examples.text_zh: 他大摇大摆的样子惹恼了整个对方队伍。

examples.text_en: He liked to swank about his new car.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢炫耀自己的新车。

examples.text_en: They swank at every party about their money.
examples.text_zh: 他们在每次聚会上都炫耀自己的钱。

examples.text_en: The swarthy old man had worked under the sun.
examples.text_zh: 这位黑黝黝的老人常年在太阳下干活。

examples.text_en: His swarthy face and hands told of long days outside.
examples.text_zh: 他黑黝黝的脸和手说明他常年在户外。

examples.text_en: A little sugar will sweeten the sour juice.
examples.text_zh: 一点糖就能把酸果汁变甜。

examples.text_en: She used honey to sweeten her morning tea.
examples.text_zh: 她用蜂蜜给早茶加甜。

examples.text_en: The sweetness of the fruit filled the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 水果的甜香充满了整个房间。

examples.text_en: He loved the sweetness of her quiet voice.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢她轻柔嗓音的甜美。

examples.text_en: There was a painful swelling on his left arm.
examples.text_zh: 他的左臂上有一处疼痛的肿胀。

examples.text_en: The swelling went down after a few cold days.
examples.text_zh: 冷敷几天后肿胀消退了。

examples.text_en: The workers began to swelter in the hot room.
examples.text_zh: 工人们在闷热的房间里开始热得难受。

examples.text_en: We swelter here every summer without a fan.
examples.text_zh: 每年夏天没有风扇，我们在这里热得汗流浃背。

examples.text_en: The swiftness of the river surprised the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 河水的迅速让整队人都吃了一惊。

examples.text_en: He moved with great swiftness toward the door.
examples.text_zh: 他以极快的速度朝门口跑去。

examples.text_en: A slow swirl of smoke rose above the fire.
examples.text_zh: 一缕烟缓缓打着旋升到火上方。

examples.text_en: The swirl of cold water pulled him under.
examples.text_zh: 冰冷的水涡把他卷到了下面。

examples.text_en: The old sybarite spent his days in fine hotels.
examples.text_zh: 这位爱奢侈享乐的老人整天待在高级酒店里。

examples.text_en: He lived like a sybarite and never worked.
examples.text_zh: 他过着奢侈享乐的生活，从不工作。

examples.text_en: Their sybaritic life was full of fine food.
examples.text_zh: 他们奢侈享乐的生活满是美食。

examples.text_en: The hotel offered a sybaritic night of rest.
examples.text_zh: 这家酒店提供了一晚极尽享受的休息。

examples.text_en: The old leader was surrounded by a sycophant.
examples.text_zh: 老领导身边围着一个谄媚者。

examples.text_en: A sycophant will say anything to please the boss.
examples.text_zh: 谄媚者为了讨好老板什么话都说得出口。

examples.text_en: The teacher gave us a clear syllabus for the course.
examples.text_zh: 老师给了我们一份清楚的课程大纲。

examples.text_en: The new syllabus lists all the books we need.
examples.text_zh: 新大纲列出了我们需要的所有书籍。

examples.text_en: The two plants live in a close symbiosis.
examples.text_zh: 这两种植物过着紧密的共栖生活。

examples.text_en: Their symbiosis helped both groups grow and grow.
examples.text_zh: 它们的共生帮助两个群体不断壮大。

examples.text_en: The two animals have a symbiotic relation.
examples.text_zh: 这两种动物有着共生的关系。

examples.text_en: They formed a symbiotic bond over many years.
examples.text_zh: 多年来它们形成了共生的纽带。

examples.text_en: The poem is full of dark colors and symbolism.
examples.text_zh: 这首诗充满了暗色与象征主义。

examples.text_en: They studied the symbolism of the old wall paintings.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了这些古老壁画的象征意义。

examples.text_en: He studies the symbology of early human art.
examples.text_zh: 他研究早期人类艺术的符号体系。

examples.text_en: Their symbology used many shapes and colors.
examples.text_zh: 他们的符号学使用了许多形状和颜色。

examples.text_en: The two sides of the building are symmetrical.
examples.text_zh: 这栋建筑的两侧是对称的。

examples.text_en: Her face was calm and almost perfectly symmetrical.
examples.text_zh: 她的脸平静，几乎完全对称。

examples.text_en: The garden was designed with great symmetry.
examples.text_zh: 这座花园的设计极具对称美。

examples.text_en: He loved the symmetry of the old stone building.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢那座古老石头建筑的对称。

examples.text_en: She was sympathetic when I told her my story.
examples.text_zh: 我把自己的经历告诉她时，她很同情。

examples.text_en: The doctor gave a sympathetic smile and listened.
examples.text_zh: 医生带着同情的微笑听着。

examples.text_en: The city held a symposium about clean water.
examples.text_zh: 市里举办了一场关于清洁用水的讨论会。

examples.text_en: Many teachers came to the symposium on new methods.
examples.text_zh: 许多教师来参加关于新方法的座谈会。

examples.text_en: The two clocks are synchronous and show the same time.
examples.text_zh: 这两个钟是同步的，显示同样的时间。

examples.text_en: Their movements were synchronous and looked like a dance.
examples.text_zh: 他们的动作同步，看起来像一支舞。

examples.text_en: A large syndicate bought the old city newspaper.
examples.text_zh: 一个大型财团买下了这家老城报纸。

examples.text_en: The syndicate controlled most of the local business.
examples.text_zh: 这个企业联合控制了当地大部分生意。
